competitors.name: Walmart / Bettergoods
competitors.action: Allrecipes reported Walmart's Bettergoods private brand added five frozen pizza offerings: four single-serve wood-fired crust pizzas and one full-size ultra-thin Butter Chicken pizza. The move extends Walmart's premium private-label frozen pizza set into bolder global and single-serve formats.

competitors.name: Albertsons Own Brands
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Albertsons' Own Brands generated $16.9 billion in fiscal 2025 retail sales across more than 14,000 exclusive products and 2,244 stores. Albertsons is using 19 company-owned manufacturing facilities to move faster in private-label frozen and beverage innovation, including limited-time flavor launches.

competitors.name: Amazon / Whole Foods Market
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Numerator Q2 2026 data showing Amazon and Whole Foods are 0.1 CPG share points behind Costco for the No. 2 U.S. CPG retailer position. Amazon and Whole Foods added 1.0 CPG share point year over year, representing more than $16 billion in spending, and posted the steepest food-and-beverage share gain among tracked retailers.
